status: VERIFIED - built by tools/build_hackenburg.py from final_data_with_metrics.csv (25,982 x 113), one issue (solitary_confinement, 2,589 rows): 73 message arms (n 4-16-119) + 524 shared control. Checks in the builder: one verbatim text per arm, no control row carries a message, the four items reproduce the study's own composite to 0.0. Arm titles are a seeded shuffle of Message 01-73 because the raw ids name the model that wrote each message.
sample_description: 2,589 U.S. adults from an opt-in online task panel (2024), each randomly assigned to read ONE ~200-word persuasive message about a single policy issue, or no message at all, and then to answer four 0-100 slider items about it. 72 of the 73 messages were generated by large language models (24 different models, three prompt phrasings each) and one was written by a human expert; the brief does not say which is which. Every message argues the same side of the issue: that the U.S. should NOT ban the use of solitary confinement for juveniles in prison. The panel skews young and Democratic-leaning. Message lengths vary from 14 to 354 words.

oppose_ban_1.question: "The U.S. should not ban the use of solitary confinement for juveniles in prison." 0 = strongly disagree, 100 = strongly agree. Higher = agrees with the side the messages argue.

oppose_ban_2.question: "Banning the use of solitary confinement for juveniles in prison is a good idea." 0 = strongly disagree, 100 = strongly agree, REVERSE-SCORED here so that higher = agrees with the side the messages argue.

oppose_ban_3.question: "Banning the use of solitary confinement for juveniles in prison would have bad consequences." 0 = strongly disagree, 100 = strongly agree. Higher = agrees with the side the messages argue.

oppose_ban_4.question: "Do you support or oppose banning the use of solitary confinement for juveniles in prison?" 0 = strongly support, 100 = strongly oppose. Higher = agrees with the side the messages argue.

moderators_unavailable.race: no race, ethnicity or Hispanic column exists in the final or the raw file
moderators_unavailable.income: no income column exists in either file

message_texts_source: the `treatment_message` column of the study's own analysis file - verbatim prose, 1:1 with `treatment_message_id`, no PDF extraction involved.

caveats: LLM-AUTHORED STIMULI. 72 of 73 arms were written by language models of widely varying capability, so a large share of the between-arm variance is message quality and on-topic-ness (corr(ATE, valence_correct) = +0.591; family means run pythia -1.2 pp to claude +19.5 pp), not choice among competent human-written frames. This is NOT evidence about human message realism and must be flagged in any scoreboard row and in the calibration decision.
per-arm n is small (min 4, median 16), which is what makes the median SE 5.7 pp
the panel is a young, Democrat-leaning convenience sample, not a census quota
two of the target's six moderators (race, income) do not exist here
the same policy issue appears in tappin2023's item bank (item 13, opposite stance), so task 6 and task 7 overlap on one issue out of 24
the upstream cleaning script that reduces 35,858 raw rows to 25,982 is not in the mirror; the carve uses the authors' own analysis file
